mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 60 trading days compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 60 trading days, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 240.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate tightening, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current CPIAUCSL at 241.002 as of t-2mo
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
